label: Google Sheets: Read
description: Read a spreadsheet's rows. Works signed in (pick a sheet, or let the picker grant one) and with nothing but a share link: leave the account unconnected and paste the link of a sheet shared with 'anyone with the link'.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: A Google account. Leave it unconnected to read sheets shared by link.

inputs.name: spreadsheet
inputs.label: Spreadsheet
inputs.placeholder: Pick one, or paste its share link

inputs.name: tab

outputs.name: rows
outputs.description: The sheet's rows. With a header, each row is {column: value}; without one, {c0, c1, ...}.
